subject: GGIR version could not extract and cannot open a connection

messages.author: 7ce09c2f5b414ed2
messages.subject: GGIR version could not extract and cannot open a connection
parts:
Happy New Year GGIR users!

I am having an issue in the initial stages of the call to GGIR, in that I am unable to process data.  I am using RStudio version 1.3.1093 and GGIR version 2.2-0.
 
I have two different errors that occur. One says "GGIR version:    could not extract version", and the other issue I am getting is that it "cannot open the connection". I have included the screenshot attached in a word document.

Any help is greatly appreciated.

Thank you,
Cory Scott

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR version could not extract and cannot open a connection
parts:
You can ignore "could not extract version", this relates to printing a context summary to the the console. It plays no role in the analysis and will be fixed in the next CRAN release, and it is already fixed in the GGIR beta-version 2.2-1 on GitHub.

The other issue may indicate:
- File is open, if yes, close it.
- File has no data. I see this is Actigraph, use Actilife to check whether there is data
- File is not a raw data file. Raw data files in csv format should be at least several 100 MB in size.
- The file is somehow not readable.

Also I gave you hints at what you could do in our other conversation, did you follow those?

Thanks,
Vincent
